features.name: Weekly external skills auto-update CI workflow
features.description: Add a workflow_dispatch + weekly-cron GitHub Action that refreshes external/ skills from their upstream sources, refreshes skills-lock.json hashes while preserving original sources, verifies repo structure with ./init.sh, and opens a PR to review/merge.
features.evidence: Commits 3e573c5, fc752c0, 150f96c, f9556e5 in .github/workflows/update-external-skills.yml. Final design: per-source-repo `npx skills add <source> -s <name1> -s <name2>... --agent universal -y` (grouped to avoid re-cloning the same upstream per skill), rsync fetched content over external/<domain>/<skill> where changed, `./setup.sh --external --agent universal` to refresh skills-lock.json hashes while preserving true upstream sources, ./init.sh structural check, drift check that no external entry went local/firstsun-dev/skills, then peter-evans/create-pull-request (RELEASE_TOKEN, since repo/org disables GITHUB_TOKEN PR creation; checkout uses persist-credentials:false to avoid a duplicate-Authorization-header conflict) with add-paths restricted to external/**+skills-lock.json as a backstop. Two prior designs failed on real CI (skills update -p ignored external/ entirely; then npx skills add with no TTY defaulted to installing into all 72 agent integrations, polluting the PR with a bogus agent/skills/ tree) before --agent universal + add-paths produced a clean run: PR #3 (https://github.com/firstsun-dev/skills/pull/3), 205 files, verified zero agent/* paths.
